title: Size and support bounds for a median (Simon 5.1, (35))
statement: Let α be a type with a σ-algebra and μ a measure on it. Let F ⊆ α be measurable, let a > 0 be real, let u : α → ℝ be measurable, and let c ∈ ℝ be a median of u on F in the sense that ofReal(a/2) ≤ μ(F ∩ {x : u(x) ≤ c}) and ofReal(a/2) ≤ μ(F ∩ {x : c ≤ u(x)}). Then (M1) ofReal(|c|·a) ≤ 2 ∫⁻_F ofReal|u| dμ, and (M2) c ≠ 0 implies μ(F ∩ {x : u(x) ≠ 0}) ≠ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a c : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → Measurable u → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≤ c}) → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | c ≤ u x}) → ENNReal.ofReal (|c| * a) ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x| ∂μ ∧ (c ≠ 0 → μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≠ 0}) ≠ 0)
